title: DFA, Supreme Court sign deal to ease recognition of foreign divorces

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and the Supreme Court signed an agreement on Wednesday to establish a centralized database of foreign divorce laws, a move aimed at making it easier and less costly for Filipinos to seek recognition of divorces obtained abroad. Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro announced the signing of the tripartite memorandum of agreement (MOA) in a post on X, describing it as a step toward helping Filipinos facing legal difficulties over their marital status. “A major win for every Filipino stuck in legal limbo—proving foreign divorce decrees in Philippine courts just got faster and easier […]... Keep on reading: DFA, Supreme Court sign deal to ease recognition of foreign divorces
